name: Scale study supplement: d5/d6 chains and native-name cities (addendum to prereg_scale.json)
why: the coordinator asked for depth to 5-6 hops and non-English descriptors; the memo's 128-item panel stops at d4, so these run as a separate panel and never enter the main panel's verdicts
panel: panel_supp.json (panel_supp.py): d5 28, d6 25, d5-short 16 (verified chains where an earlier entity already shares the final country or capital), native-city 28, english-city 28 (the same cities by English name); facts from fact_pools_draft.json, second-reader verified (fact_pools_verified.json: 0 wrong hops; only 'pass' items used)
jobs: per model: Job C capture (capture.py, PANEL=panel_supp.json) and A1 sweep (sweep.py) only; no forecasts and no A2 arms; scored by score.py with CARRIER fixed to the model carrier found on the main panel (L_c, kv_c)

predictions_builder_asserted.S1_depth_collapse: per model, accuracy(d5) <= accuracy(d4-work on the main panel) and accuracy(d6) <= accuracy(d5); judged where n >= 8
predictions_builder_asserted.S2_shortcut: accuracy(d5-short) > accuracy(d5) on every model (skipping a hop still answers)
predictions_builder_asserted.S3_readable_errors: B4 extended: in every d5/d6 cell with accuracy < 0.5 the readable-error share of wrong items is >= 0.60
predictions_builder_asserted.S4_L_first: median L_first over correct items at d5 and d6 is not earlier than at d4 (same statistic and chance guard as prereg_hopbudget.json; reported as chance-dominated where the guard fires)
predictions_builder_asserted.S5_native_names: accuracy(native-city) < accuracy(english-city) on every model, and on native-city wrong items the carrier names a wrong country or ranks the true one > 3 on >= 0.70 (recall failure, the obsc reading); on items correct in both, the carrier names the country on >= 0.80 in both

falsifiers.S1: d6 accuracy above d4 by >= 0.15 on any model
falsifiers.S5: native-city wrong items with the carrier naming the true country on >= 0.50 (the error is downstream of the cell)
